```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

### Read In Datasets
```{r}
filepath <- "results/final_training"

training_files <- list.files(
  filepath,
  pattern = "train.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

testing_files <- list.files(
  filepath,
  pattern = "test.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

### Create Datasets
```{r}
combined_training_data <- training_files %>%
  map_df(read_csv)

combined_training_data
```


```{r}
combined_test_data <- test_files %>%
  map_df(read_csv)

combined_test_data
```

### Create Patch Datasets
```{r}
patch_train_dataset <- combined_training_data %>%
  group_by(patch) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = epoch, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
patch_test_dataset <- combined_test_data %>%
  group_by(patch) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = epoch, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### Draw Training Graphs
```{r}
ggplot(combined_training_data, aes(x = epoch, y = loss)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Loss",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Loss"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(combined_training_data, aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Voxel-Wise Agreement",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Voxel-Wise Agreement"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
testing_files <- list.files(
  filepath,
  pattern = ".*test.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

testing_files
```
```{r}
combined_testing_data <- testing_files %>%
  map_df(~ {
    filename <- basename(.x)
    
    epoch <- str_extract(filename, "\\d+") %>%
      as.numeric()
    
    read_csv(.x) %>%
      mutate(epoch = epoch)
  })

combined_testing_data
```


```{r}
ggplot(combined_testing_data, aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Voxel-Wise Agreement",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Voxel-Wise Agreement"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(combined_testing_data, aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy_bg)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Accuracy Background",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Accuracy Background"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(combined_testing_data, aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy_class_1)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Accuracy Cortical Bone",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Accuracy Cortical Bone"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(combined_testing_data, aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy_class_2)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Accuracy Trabecular Bone",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Accuracy Trabecular Bone"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(combined_testing_data, aes(x = epoch, y = mean_iou)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Mean IoU",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Mean IoU"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
combined_long <- combined_testing_data %>%
  select(epoch, accuracy_bg, accuracy_class_1, accuracy_class_2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(accuracy_bg, accuracy_class_1, accuracy_class_2),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "accuracy"
  ) %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(metric,
    accuracy_bg = "Background",
    accuracy_class_1 = "Cortical Bone",
    accuracy_class_2 = "Trabecular Bone"
  ))

# Plot
ggplot(combined_long, aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Epoch vs Voxel-Wise Agreement by Class",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Accuracy",
    color = "Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
